independent_transcript: The corrected register lies open beneath the archive window. Twenty-three names, no longer a number in the margin. Decide to most veils entry, the old accusation remains visible under single ruled line. The correction cites its evidence. Nobody has scraped the page clean. Rusk is removed from emergency office and referred to an outside court with the original records. Elian gives testimony without a promise of immunity. Rowan's account includes both the people he helped and the order he obeyed. Truth is not a pardon, and this city has begun to understand the difference. Mara establishes duplicate archives on both sides of the water. Sarah prints the findings at cost. Naughty carries the first public copies to the island. Ada restores the midnight signal, which sounds without commanding anyone to be silent. You stay to teach two apprentices. One asks whether a repair ought to be invisible. You hold the folio against the light. The seam shines, delicate and unmistakable. It ought to hold, you say, and it ought to tell the truth. The End.
